channel.description: The leading newsroom covering the transition to clean energy, electrification and climate solutions. We report on how the world is decarbonizing with a critical focus on finding out what works and what doesn't.

item.title: This group-buy campaign makes it easier to switch to induction cooking
item.description: Word is getting out about electric induction ranges. More and more chefs say the appliances cook just as well as or better than their gas counterparts. The stoves don’t burn climate-warming fossil fuels or release harmful indoor air pollutants like gas ones do. And because they’re vastly more efficient, they also…
